findings.passage: “I think you’re trying to cure a problem in your mind,” said Sen. Ed Harbison, D-Columbus, the Senate’s longest-serving member. “But the truth is, it opens the privacy door.”
findings.note: Quoted by Capitol Beat during the Senate Ethics Committee vote on Sen. Larry Walker III's bill to require a driver's license or ID number to request an absentee ballot (the committee passed it 7-4). He says the problem is not real and that sending ID details raises a privacy concern.
